Found 10 related table(s):

--- Table 1: adventureworks.humanresources.department ---
Domain: Organization
Description: Lookup table storing the official list of departments within Adventure Works Cycles, used as a reference to categorize employees, assign organizational responsibilities, and define company structure for HR and reporting purposes.
Fields:
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): The timestamp recording when the department information was most recently updated in the system
  - groupname (character varying(50)): The organizational group or division that the department belongs to, representing higher-level company structure (e.g., Manufacturing, Executive, Research and Development)
  - name (character varying(50)): The official business name or title of the department (e.g., Engineering, Sales, Marketing)
  - departmentid (integer(32,0)) [PK]: A unique sequential identifier assigned to each department record in the system
Match reason: Source: vector

--- Table 2: adventureworks.production.productsubcategory ---
Domain: Product
Description: Product subcategories. See ProductCategory table.
Fields:
  - productsubcategoryid (integer(32,0)) [PK]: Primary key identifier that uniquely represents each product subcategory within the system
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): Timestamp indicating when the subcategory record was last modified for audit and synchronization purposes
  - name (character varying(50)): The business name of the product subcategory (e.g., Mountain Bikes, Road Frames, Touring Bicycles)
  - rowguid (uuid): Globally unique identifier used for database replication and data synchronization across systems
  - productcategoryid (integer(32,0)) [FK]: Foreign key reference to the parent product category, establishing the hierarchical relationship between category and subcategory
Match reason: Source: vector

--- Table 3: adventureworks.production.productdescription ---
Domain: Product
Description: Product descriptions in several languages.
Fields:
  - productdescriptionid (integer(32,0)) [PK]: Primary key identifier for the product description record
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): Date and time when the product description was last modified or updated
  - description (character varying(400)): The actual textual description content of a product, typically in a specific language
  - rowguid (uuid): Globally unique identifier assigned to each row for database replication and synchronization purposes
Match reason: Source: vector

--- Table 4: adventureworks.purchasing.shipmethod ---
Domain: Shipping
Description: Shipping company lookup table.
Fields:
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): Date and time when the shipping method record was last modified
  - shiprate (numeric): Additional per-unit or variable shipping rate charged for this method
  - shipbase (numeric): Base or flat rate cost for using this shipping method
  - rowguid (uuid): Globally unique identifier assigned to each shipping method for cross-system data synchronization
  - shipmethodid (integer(32,0)) [PK]: Primary key identifier for the shipping method record
  - name (character varying(50)): Name of the shipping company or method (e.g., UPS, FedEx, DHL, overnight, ground)
Match reason: Source: vector

--- Table 5: adventureworks.humanresources.shift ---
Domain: Human Resources
Description: Work shift lookup table.
Fields:
  - endtime (time without time zone): Scheduled end time of the work shift
  - shiftid (integer(32,0)) [PK]: Primary key and unique identifier for each work shift record
  - name (character varying(50)): Descriptive name of the shift such as Day, Evening, or Night shift
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): Audit timestamp recording when the shift record was last updated
  - starttime (time without time zone): Scheduled start time of the work shift
Match reason: Source: vector

--- Table 6: adventureworks.production.culture ---
Domain: Localization
Description: Lookup table containing the languages in which some AdventureWorks data is stored.
Fields:
  - name (character varying(50)): The display name of the language or culture (e.g., English, Spanish, French)
  - cultureid (character(6)) [PK]: The standardized culture identifier code (e.g., en-US, es-MX) used to format dates, numbers, and currency for specific regions
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): The timestamp recording when this language or culture record was last modified in the system
Match reason: Source: vector

--- Table 7: adventureworks.person.businessentity ---
Domain: Business Entity
Description: Source of the ID that connects vendors, customers, and employees with address and contact information.
Fields:
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): Date and time when the business entity record was last modified, supporting audit trails and data synchronization processes
  - rowguid (uuid): Globally unique identifier assigned to each business entity record, used for database replication, synchronization, or as an alternative unique key
  - businessentityid (integer(32,0)) [PK]: Primary key and unique numeric identifier for each business entity, used as the common reference to link customers, vendors, and employees to their addresses and contact details
Match reason: Source: vector

--- Table 8: adventureworks.sales.store ---
Domain: Store
Description: Customers (resellers) of Adventure Works products.
Fields:
  - salespersonid (integer(32,0)) [FK]: Identifier of the salesperson assigned to manage and support this store account
  - demographics (xml): XML document containing store demographic information including location type, sales territory, and business characteristics
  - rowguid (uuid): Globally unique identifier assigned to each store record for system-wide reference
  - name (character varying(50)): Official business name of the store or reseller entity
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): Timestamp indicating when the store record was last updated in the system
  - businessentityid (integer(32,0)) [PK]: Foreign key reference to the core business entity table containing foundational information about this store organization
Match reason: Source: vector

--- Table 9: adventureworks.production.illustration ---
Domain: Product
Description: Bicycle assembly diagrams.
Fields:
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): Timestamp indicating when the bicycle assembly diagram was last modified or updated
  - illustrationid (integer(32,0)) [PK]: Unique identifier for each bicycle assembly diagram illustration record
  - diagram (xml): XML-formatted assembly diagram containing visual instructions for bicycle component assembly
Match reason: Source: vector

--- Table 10: adventureworks.production.productcosthistory ---
Domain: Product
Description: Changes in the cost of a product over time.
Fields:
  - enddate (timestamp without time zone): The last date when this cost version was effective; after this date, a new cost superseded this record
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): The date and time when this cost record was last updated or modified in the system
  - standardcost (numeric): The monetary value representing the standard cost of the product during this effective period
  - startdate (timestamp without time zone) [PK]: The first date when this cost version became effective and was used for valuation purposes
  - productid (integer(32,0)) [PK] [FK]: The unique identifier of the product for which this cost history record applies
Match reason: Source: vector
